title: 100 Daily Use English Phrases | Listen and Repeat Practice
description:
100 daily use English phrases to listen to and repeat: greetings, mornings at home, asking for help, shopping, eating out, getting around, work and study, feelings, making plans and saying good night. This is English speaking practice for every day, about 25 minutes long.

How to practice: listen to the phrase, say it out loud in the pause, then listen and say it again. After each part, you say all ten phrases once more. Every tenth phrase is a stronger or more natural way to say something simple, for example "I'm doing great, thanks" instead of "I'm fine."
